This booking confirmation is subject to receiving of all relevant bill of lading / sea waybill data from the shipper in due time respectively according 
to local documentation closing dates/times.

 
*** ICS2 *** 
As per ICS2 rules: If you would like us to file a full ENS 
(i.e. incl. house level and/or buyer/seller data), 
please provide us with the relevant data in your 
shipping instructions within doc / SI cut off, 
otherwise please submit the EORI of the 
next filing party (self-filer / supplementary declarant). 
Please note that EU customs authorities will require 
complete ENS data from 1 September 2025. 
If you do not provide us with your partial ENS data,

IT IS THE SHIPPER'S RESPONSIBILITY TO PROVIDE THE CORRECT HS CODE 
TOGETHER WITH ITS SHIPPING INSTRUCTIONS. IN CASE NO HS CODE IS 
PROVIDED BY SHIPPER THE CARRIER WILL SELECT A HS CODE. IN THIS CASE, 
THE CARRIER IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CONSEQUENCE OF AN INCORRECT HS 
CODE UTILIZED FOR MANIFESTING OF THE SHIPMENT. 
 
AT TIME OF BOOKING IT IS SHIPPER'S RESPONSIBILITY TO DECLARE 
EXPRESSLY WHETHER OR NOT THE CARGO CONTAINS ANY DG (DANGEROUS GOODS). 
ANY COSTS, FINES AND/OR PENALTIES RESULTING FROM THE VIOLATION OF 
THIS RESPONSIBILITY WILL BE FOR CARGOS ACCOUNT. 
 
// NON QUICK QUOTES SPOT(QQS) BOOKING ON ALL SERVICES // 
 
PLEASE BE INFORMED OF THE FOLLOWING CHANGES OF OUR BOOKING 
CANCELLATION POLICY WITH EFFECT FROM AUGUST 1, 2024 UNTIL FURTHER 
NOTICE. 
 
BOOKING CANCELLATION FEE (CNY300 PER TEU FOR CHINA EXPORT / HKD300 PER 
 
TEU FOR HONGKONG EXPORT) IS APPLICABLE TO BOOKINGS CANCELLED, REDUCED, 
 
OR NO-SHOW WITHIN 7 CALENDAR DAYS PRIOR TO THE ESTIMATED TIME OF 
DEPARTURE (ETD) OF THE FIRST INTENDED VESSEL DESTINED TO ALL TRADES 
EXCLUDING INTRA ASIA (SHORT SEA). 
 
FOR THE INTRA ASIA (SHORT SEA) TRADE, THE BOOKING CANCELLATION FEE 
WILL NOT BE APPLICABLE.

To assist you with the preparation of shipping instructions, we have prepared the following guidelines for you: 
Shipping Instruction General Guideline 
 
*** BOOKING AMENDMENT *** 
 
To be working with us faster and easier, we kindly request all 
booking amendment requests be submitted via the Hapag-Lloyd Booking 
Amendment e-form. All booking amendment requests via email or phone 
calls has been discontinued since December 1, 2022. 
 
Please use the following link:HAPAG-LLOYD BOOKING AMENDMENT e-FORM 
 
Alternatively, you can access all your shipment information here:https://solutions.hapag-lloyd.com/navigator-v2 
 
Please visit the user guide for more information: 
HAPAG-LLOYD BOOKING AMENDMENT USERGUIDE 
 
IN ORDER FOR HAPAG-LLOYD TO COMPLY WITH THE SSE (SHANGHAI SHIPPING 
EXCHANGE) REGULATION, ALL SHIPMENTS FROM CHINA (EXCLUDING HONG KONG, 
MACAU) NEED TO HAVE A RATE FILED 3 WORKING DAYS PRIOR TO THE 
SCHEDULED VESSEL DEPARTURE. ANY SHIPMENT NOT MEETING THIS DEADLINE 
WILL NOT BE LOADED, AND ALL COSTS RELATING TO THE SHUT-OUT ARE FOR 
THE ACCOUNT OF THE SHIPPER. 
 
Please refer to Hapag-Lloyd website for detention and demurrage tariff 
Detention and Demurrage Tariffs 
 
PLEASE REFER TO TERMINAL WEB INFORMATION FOR ACTUAL TERMINAL FCL 
DELIVERY CUT-OFF TIME DUE TO FINAL SCHEDULE THAT IS FINALLY DECIDED BY 
TERMINAL.

IT IS SHIPPER'S RESPONSIBILITY TO DECLARE EXPLICITLY WHETHER OR NOT 
THE CARGO IN THE BOOKING CONTAINS ANY CHARCOAL, CARBON BLACK, 
ACTIVATED CARBON, LITHIUM BATTERY AND PROVIDE HAPAG-LLOYD BOOKING TEAM 
WITH MSDS DOCUMENT AND/OR SELF-HEATING TEST REPORT IF ANY. ANY COSTS, 
FINES AND/OR PENALTIES RESULTING FROM NOT INFORMING CARRIERS PRIOR TO 
MT PICK-UP WILL BE UNDER SHIPPER'S ACCOUNT. THE BOOKING CONFIRMATION 
IS SUBJECT TO SPECIAL STOWAGE APPROVED BY VESSEL OPERATOR'S OWN 
DISCRETION AND ALL COSTS RELATING TO THE SHUT-OUT IS ON THE ACCOUNT OF 
THE SHIPPER.

     
All dates/times are best reasonable estimates and may change. The booking confirmation is subject to sealing of container with high security 
seals by shipper. Container stowage on vessel is in Carrier's discretion. Carrier operates under its Bill of Lading/Sea Waybill terms and 
conditions which are incorporated herein by reference with the same force and effect as though fully set forth herein and which will be provided 
upon request or displayed in any of Carrier's/its agent's offices or under www.hapag-lloyd.com, containing liability limitations deviating from 
German law. As to VGM, CL 11.2 applies and shipper agrees that submission of VGM by third parties on his behalf shall be deemed authorized 
if such message shows: Match of container and shipment number, name of responsible party (shipper) and person authorized by shipper. Carrier 
may ask for further information due to country requirements and relies in the correctness of the transmitted data. Carrier will not verify 
authorization or VGM. Shipper shall monitor its VGM on  www.hapag-lloyd.com/en/my_shipments.html and shall notify Carrier promptly if VGM is 
not correct.
